subject_summary: Observed keyboard navigation is largely linear and consecutive. Confirmed patterns include browser-to-page entry at the logo (P04), several adjacent cross-region continuations between header/main/footer sections (P01), and many consecutive transitions within distinct navigation, publications, and footer subgroups (P05). One footer legal-link transition matches local auxiliary-control progression (P03). No evidence supports wraparound, backward local movement, helper-link field patterns, or primary-control bypass patterns.
